notes: How a conversation with Captain Titus opens, comes back to the topics, and ends.
Her voice (CAPTAIN.md 1): steady, dry, tired, plain. She owns her decisions and
does not make speeches. She never says who the player is (CAPTAIN.md 6); %1 is
how she addresses them, built from what they have told her and their rank.
The promotion nodes are the only thing she does rather than says (CAPTAIN.md
4.13): a rank the player's rescues have earned, given in person.

lines.text: She looks up from a padd. She doesn't get up.
You came up off Lieutenant Shepard's shuttle. The pad logged it.
Imogen Titus. I command this ship, for what that's worth now.
I don't get many visitors from the surface. Sit, if you like.
And you are?
%1. Thank you. I'll remember it.
Ask me what you need to. I'll tell you what I can.
Not to me. Plenty of people down there had reasons.
Ask me what you need to. I'll tell you what I can.
She stands up for this one.
You've been bringing my people home. I know about every one.
A captain out of contact acts on her own authority. So I will.
As of today you hold a field commission. %2.
I don't care what you were before. You're one of mine now.

options.text: I didn't do it for a rank.

lines.text: I know. That's why you have one.
She stands for this one too.
More of mine came up the transporter because of you.
%2, as of now. Rhel is machining the pips. Wear them.
Half my bridge officers haven't done what you've done this month.
On this ship it's real. I signed it myself.
If Starfleet ever hears from us, they can argue with me.
She reads your face before you say anything.
Shepard's told you. I can see it on you.
Sit down, %1. Ask me anything you want about it.
%1. Sit down. What do you need?
She puts the padd face down on the arm of the chair.
Back again. Good. Go ahead.
%1. Tell me you've eaten today, and then ask.
The helm officer finds somewhere else to be.
You have the chair next to mine, %1. What is it?
What else?
Go on.
Anything else, %1?
Go carefully down there.
Eat something. That isn't a suggestion.
She turns the padd back over.
Come back when you have news. Or when you don't.
Dismissed, %1. That's a joke. Mostly.
